name: rank-bars
title: Rank Bars
description: Horizontal ranking bars — label, zero-based bar, value — with an accent-highlighted hero row.

meta.question: Who leads this ranking, and by how much?
meta.whenToUse: Comparing one metric across a handful of named entities where order and gaps matter (leaderboards, price ladders).
meta.antiUse: Not for time series, part-to-whole composition, or more than ~10 rows — use a table or sparklines instead.
